version: LOCK 28 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - the regulars remember
builds_on: LOCK 6 talking (tier line, fact line), LOCKs 9-25 (what each regular saw or heard). One extra line: the first memory in each list that is true.

salma: “I saw the jars at the quay at night. I said nothing. Others will.”
“My children drink from your fountain every morning.”
“Half this street has eaten your bread. They know who paid.”
rashid: “Thirty-six for thirty. I have not forgotten.”
“I still owe Mansur because of you.”
“They say you dice behind the blue cloth. Is that where my customers' coins go?”
“Ten coins you let go. I tell everyone who buys pepper.”
“You waited for me. If you ever need time, I will wait for you.”
layla: “Faris showed me his slate. He can write his name now.”
“I wash my threads at your fountain. The colours have never been brighter.”
jamal: “Qasim's boat ties up at my quay at night. I know what it carries, and who carries it.”
“I saw the Kaaba. Because of you. I will never forget it.”
“Someone sent me to Makkah. Allah knows who. I pray for them every night.”
musa: “Fifty years at the scales, and then the Kaaba. I pray for you every night.”
“Someone paid for my Umrah. I will never know who. Allah knows.”
“You read the word on my beam. Al-Hasib. Then you understand my work.”
